entries.name: Foundation Guard Set
entries.description: Runs the registered targeted foundation guard set; a pass is scoped static evidence only.

entries.name: Journey Guard Set
entries.description: Runs the targeted journey guard set without implying runtime or final closure.

entries.name: Journey Runtime Guard Set
entries.description: Runs journey verification with explicit runtime scope; evidence remains candidate and scope bound.

entries.name: UI Kit Boundary Gate
entries.description: Enforces reusable UI ownership and import boundaries.

entries.name: Fullstack Boundary Gate
entries.description: Enforces declared frontend, backend, contract, and ownership boundaries.

entries.name: WLT Financial Boundary Gate
entries.description: Preserves WLT ownership of financial truth and rejects selected duplicate financial mutation paths.

entries.name: Runtime Configuration Gate
entries.description: Validates runtime configuration ownership and fail-closed defaults without claiming runtime execution.

entries.name: No Broken Imports Gate
entries.description: Validates supported repository imports resolve to existing modules.

entries.name: Cleanup Policy Gate
entries.description: Rejects configured retired roots, labels, transient outputs, and fake-truth patterns.

entries.name: Contract Registry Drift Gate
entries.description: Rejects drift between canonical contract sources and the committed generated contract registry.

entries.name: Migration Manifest Drift Gate
entries.description: Rejects missing, unregistered, reordered, checksum-drifted, or prefix-colliding migrations.

entries.name: Generated Client Provenance Gate
entries.description: Verifies generated client provenance and reproducibility from committed canonical contracts.

entries.name: Contract Scope Binding Gate
entries.description: Requires authorization scopes used by supported routes to exist in the canonical scope vocabulary.

entries.name: OpenAPI Bundle Provenance Gate
entries.description: Rejects composed OpenAPI bundle drift from canonical modular source files.

entries.name: WLT OpenAPI Bundle Gate
entries.description: Verifies WLT OpenAPI composition and generated artifacts against canonical sources.

entries.name: API Contract Binding Gate
entries.description: Validates supported OpenAPI and generated-client compatibility.

entries.name: Backend API Binding Gate
entries.description: Reconciles supported backend route registrations with API contracts.

entries.name: Service Manifest Drift Gate
entries.description: Validates canonical service capability ownership and contract-operation coverage.

entries.name: Frontend Static Binding Gate
entries.description: Verifies declared static screen-controller-contract-route-capability reachability.

entries.name: Required Command Integrity Gate
entries.description: Rejects required verification commands/workflows that drift, swallow failures, mutate source, or target invalid runtime contracts.

entries.name: Go Route AST Gate
entries.description: Extracts supported Go route registrations from source AST without claiming endpoint reachability.

entries.name: Static Logic Heuristic Gate
entries.description: Rejects selected dead-action and local-stub patterns without claiming complete behavioral coverage.

entries.name: Static Accessibility Gate
entries.description: Checks selected static accessibility contracts.

entries.name: Dependency Graph Gate
entries.description: Validates configured dependency layering and prohibited cycles.

entries.name: AST Structural Rules Gate
entries.description: Applies registered structural AST rules.

entries.name: UI Provider Required Gate
entries.description: Requires configured UI provider composition.

entries.name: Icon Contract Gate
entries.description: Enforces icon ownership and usage contracts.

entries.name: Design Token Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports configured design-token and spacing anomalies.

entries.name: Brand Identity Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports bounded static brand-identity findings without visual approval.

entries.name: Repository Size Gate
entries.description: Rejects configured forbidden tracked outputs and oversized repository artifacts.

entries.name: Repository Naming Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports naming drift while registered legacy exceptions remain.

entries.name: Repository Structure Gate
entries.description: Validates approved roots, retired-root absence, bounded directory depth, canonical shared roots, and selected cross-service boundaries.

entries.name: Heavy Import Gate
entries.description: Rejects configured prohibited heavy imports in governed source scopes.

entries.name: Performance Budget Configuration Gate
entries.description: Validates performance budget configuration without claiming measured performance.

entries.name: Bundle Budget Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports configured bundle-size/dependency budget drift.

entries.name: Governance Contract Gate
entries.description: Validates the minimal authority-only governance layout, schemas, Product Truth, authority coverage, and cross-registry invariants.

entries.name: Same-Commit Evidence Gate
entries.description: Rejects recorded remediation evidence whose source SHA does not equal the current candidate.

entries.name: Workflow Temp Files Gate
entries.description: Rejects unregistered or expired temporary workflow files.

entries.name: Canonical Paths Gate
entries.description: Rejects retired/superseded live paths and duplicate canonical document titles.

entries.name: Orphan Files Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports narrow orphan-file signals without deleting source.

entries.name: Document Authority Conflicts Gate
entries.description: Rejects authority classification drift, stale operational references, hidden authority documents, and machine-specific runtime documentation.

entries.name: Flaky Tests Gate
entries.description: Validates the governed flaky-test quarantine and rejects expired unresolved entries.

entries.name: Agent System Aggregate Gate
entries.description: Runs the registered agent/governance/toolchain integrity checks together.

entries.name: Agent and Skill Governance Gate
entries.description: Validates governed skills, dependencies, routing, agent roles, adapters, and retired policy layers.

entries.name: Authority Separation Gate
entries.description: Enforces logical authority ownership and protected approval separation.

entries.name: Guard Registry and CI Policy Gate
entries.description: Validates the canonical guard inventory, commands, assurance, workflows, permissions, and immutable references.

entries.name: Direct Work Branch Execution Gate
entries.description: Validates direct-work branch semantics, stale-SHA safety, same-branch writes, no automatic task branches/PRs, and no force push.

entries.name: Objective Nomenclature Guard
entries.description: Validates canonical platform terminology and rejects forbidden internal/legacy labels in governed scopes.

entries.name: SDLC Contract Gate
entries.description: Validates SDLC lifecycle contracts, impact routing, approvals, evidence scopes, and supplied transition artifacts.

entries.name: Markdown Governance Gate
entries.description: Runs registered Markdown style validation over governed documentation surfaces.

entries.name: Secrets Detection Gate
entries.description: Runs the registered secret scanner with redacted output.

entries.name: Tool Catalog Coverage Gate
entries.description: Validates tool catalog schema, IDs, and registration coverage.

entries.name: Toolchain Activation Gate
entries.description: Validates catalog, baseline, scripts, workflows, and activation-state consistency.

entries.name: OSS Toolchain Policy Gate
entries.description: Enforces registered open-source/free-tool metadata policy.

entries.name: Workflow Syntax Gate
entries.description: Runs actionlint against GitHub Actions workflows.

entries.name: Workflow Static Security Gate
entries.description: Runs the registered workflow static-security scanner.

entries.name: Actions Immutable Pinning Gate
entries.description: Rejects external GitHub Actions that are not pinned to immutable commit SHAs.

entries.name: Rego Policy Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports Rego style/quality findings.

entries.name: OPA Policy Gate
entries.description: Runs Conftest/OPA enforcement implementation against governed registry inputs.

entries.name: Shell Script Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports ShellCheck findings.

entries.name: Dockerfile Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports Dockerfile lint findings.

entries.name: YAML Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports YAML formatting findings.

entries.name: Repository Naming Diagnostics
entries.description: Reports ls-lint naming findings.

entries.name: Runtime-Facing Static Anti-Stub Gate
entries.description: Rejects selected fake, preview, placeholder, and in-memory success patterns in runtime-facing source.

entries.name: Field Surface Truth Gate
entries.description: Enforces field-surface static truth ownership and stable error/recovery contracts.

entries.name: DSH Modular OpenAPI Gate
entries.description: Validates modular DSH OpenAPI composition and generated-client source of truth.

entries.name: DSH Route Declaration Gate
entries.description: Requires implemented DSH routes to be represented by canonical OpenAPI or an explicit reviewed exception.

entries.name: DSH Route Permission Binding Gate
entries.description: Verifies supported DSH routes resolve a reachable permission check.

entries.name: Go Handler Generation Gate
entries.description: Rejects exported DSH/WLT HTTP handlers unreferenced within their backend tree.

entries.name: Dispatch Contract Registry Gate
entries.description: Verifies dispatch OpenAPI and contract-registry ownership/path consistency.

entries.name: Local Dev Actors Registry Gate
entries.description: Keeps the local-development actor registry and non-importing consumers consistent.

entries.name: Accessibility Runtime Gate
entries.description: Runs registered Playwright/axe runtime accessibility checks and propagates failure.

entries.name: AI Toolchain Environment Gate
entries.description: Validates registered AI toolchain environment readiness without upgrading it into authority.
